newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA corn export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 516,800 MT were 18 percent below the previous week and 27 percent under the 4-week average.
The primary purchasers were Japan (166,600 MT), Colombia (108,100 MT), Mexico (72,800 MT), and Saudi Arabia (62,600 MT). Decreases of 88,100 MT were reported for Taiwan.
Sales of 256,200 MT for delivery in 1997/98 were mainly for Japan (153,400 MT).

Exports of 666,800 MT were 5 percent less than the week earlier and one-tenth below the 4-week average. The principal recipients were Mexico (163,100 MT), Taiwan (113,400 MT), Spain (74,400 MT), Japan (63,900 MT), and Saudi Arabia (62,600 MT).
